COMPATIBILITY: Preserve flags, compiled-pattern flag errors, lazy iterator/tuple result types, named/group values and all other operations. from devtools.core.regex import find_all_regex,iter_regex,search_regex,replace_regex
import re,itertools
try: matches=find_all_regex("banana","ana",overlapping=True)
except TypeError as e: raise AssertionError("overlapping search not supported") from e
assert [m.span for m in matches]==[(1,4),(3,6)]
assert [m.value for m in matches]==["ana","ana"]
assert tuple(iter_regex("banana","ana",overlapping=True))==matches
assert [m.span for m in find_all_regex("banana","ana")]==[(1,4)]
assert [m.span for m in find_all_regex("aaaa","aa",overlapping=True)]==[(0,2),(1,3),(2,4)]
zero=tuple(itertools.islice(iter_regex("ab",r"(?=.)",overlapping=True),5))
assert [m.span for m in zero]==[(0,0),(1,1)]
assert [m.span for m in find_all_regex("ab",r"$",overlapping=True)]==[(2,2)]
assert [m.span for m in find_all_regex("",r"",overlapping=True)]==[(0,0)]
assert find_all_regex("abc","z",overlapping=True)==()
named=find_all_regex("AaA",r"(?P<x>aa)",flags=re.I,overlapping=True)
assert [m.span for m in named]==[(0,2),(1,3)] and named[0].named_group("x")=="Aa"
assert find_all_regex("aaa",re.compile("aa"),overlapping=True)[-1].span==(1,3)
try: find_all_regex("a",re.compile("a"),flags=re.I,overlapping=True)
except ValueError: pass
else: raise AssertionError("compiled pattern flag error lost")
assert search_regex("abc","b").span==(1,2)
assert replace_regex("aa","a","b")=="bb"
print("14 overlapping regex compatibility checks passed")
